readme.text: FlexicaAI — Manual QA Test Cases

Every test case in this workbook was written against the actual codebase. Nothing here describes a feature that is not implemented. Where the brief this was written from assumed a feature that does not exist, it is listed on the Feature Coverage sheet as NOT IMPLEMENTED rather than silently dropped.
How to use the All Test Cases sheet
The Status column is deliberately empty — fill it in as you execute. The header row is frozen and filtered, so you can filter by Role or Module to hand a slice to one tester.
Rows tinted AMBER are BLOCKED: they cannot pass yet for a known environmental reason stated in their Preconditions. Do not raise defects for these. See the AI note below.
Read this before testing the AI scribe

The AI feature is a CLINICAL SCRIBE, not a general audio-transcription tool. A doctor dictates; OpenAI Whisper produces a transcript; Anthropic Claude turns that transcript into a STRUCTURED CLINICAL NOTE; the note is saved as a DRAFT that a clinician must review and approve before it becomes part of the record.

It uses TWO different vendors, and they are keyed separately. At the time this workbook was generated, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was configured but OPENAI_API_KEY was NOT. Transcription therefore cannot complete: a run fails at the Whisper step, the visit lands in the 'failed' state, and the recording is kept so it can be retried.

Cases are split accordingly. Everything up to and including the failure path is executable today: recording, upload limits, the rate limit, the failed state, retry, audio retention, permissions and data isolation. Cases that need a real transcript are marked [BLOCKED: needs OPENAI_API_KEY] and tinted amber. Once the key is added, re-run that filtered set — no other change is needed.
There are FIVE roles, not four
Clinic-side: clinic_admin, manager, doctor, receptionist — all share one workspace at /clinic and differ only by permission.

Company-side: super_admin works in a separate panel at /admin. It belongs to the software vendor, not to a clinic: it creates clinics, sets subscriptions and capabilities, and can view a clinic read-only. A super_admin has no clinic of their own. Many of the restricted-access cases in this workbook exist to prove that boundary holds.
Two-tier permissions

Effective access = the CLINIC's capability INTERSECTED WITH the USER's permission. The super admin grants a clinic its capabilities and features; the clinic admin then grants each user resource:action slugs within that. A feature switched off for the clinic cannot be re-enabled by any user permission — so if a screen is missing, check the clinic's features before filing a bug.
A clinic whose capabilities are NULL means 'everything allowed', not 'nothing allowed'.
Behaviour that looks like a bug and is not

An unmatched URL inside /clinic or /admin returns HTTP 200 with a not-found page rather than a 404 status. This is a deliberate consequence of the Content-Security-Policy design and applies to every not-found inside the panels.
Nothing is ever hard-deleted. 'Delete' moves a record to Trash, where it can be restored within the clinic's retention window. The only true deletion is a super-admin legal purge.

Impersonation ('Open workspace / view as clinic') is strictly read-only, and the payment-due notice and the account-manager notice are both suppressed while impersonating. Use a real clinic login to test those two.
A discount can sit at zero on the bill while it waits for approval. That is the approval workflow working, not a calculation error.
Money figures only become revenue once an appointment is marked completed. Collecting before completion is allowed and relabels the figures as an estimate and a deposit.
Test data you will need
One clinic with the 'Sales & procedures' feature enabled (payments, invoices and procedures are invisible without it), and one with it disabled to test the negative cases.

One active user per role: clinic_admin, manager, doctor, receptionist — plus a super_admin. At least two doctors, one with configured working hours and a daily cap, one with flexible hours. At least one doctor with a consultation fee of zero.
A doctor on leave for a known date range, a patient with an outstanding balance, a patient with advance credit, and a second clinic to prove tenant isolation.
Regenerating this workbook

The cases live in scripts/qa/test-cases.json and the workbook is built by scripts/qa/build-test-cases.mjs. Edit the JSON and re-run the script rather than editing the .xlsx, so changes are reviewable in a diff and the file can be rebuilt when the app changes.
